steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Careful! I think we fell into a mine!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Like the worker said earlier, the slugs made a nest here!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They colonized this place because the factory's about to shut down?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Anyone see any Goldglitter slugs?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think these are just normal slugs.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Let's go before they notice us!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...Don't see any Goldglitters here either. They're all the normal kind.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: 'Bob's Gourmet Guide' says that Goldglitter Originium slugs are a common variety in the wilds. 'They live within cracks in rocks or in caves,' and 'they behave identically to other varieties of Originium slug'...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So we should be able to find some here...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Do you really not feel anything on top of your head?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Huh? Ah!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: This is an Originium slug larva! Looks like its shell has just grown in, so it's still rather soft.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And it's busy secreting mucus to harden the shell, which raises its body temperature. It's actually quite snug and cozy having it crawl on my head like this.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Want to try, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Absolutely not!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I have a bad feeling about going any further.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: It sounds like there's other animals in here.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: We should head back.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We still haven't found any Goldglitters, though.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Do they really live here?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Maybe we can use something like golden powder instead for the carrots?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Let's go a little deeper. I don't want to let those lads down when they're hoping with all their heart.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And if we don't find those slugs, we might not be able to buy that truck.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: True...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Shh, walk quieter!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: There's a group behind us, don't think they're Goldglitters though... They don't look gold, at least.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What are they?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Acid Originium slugs!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Remember? Big Bob said their mucus is extremely corrosive! Don't get splashed by it!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Don't overdo it and kill them all!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: That really doesn't matter right now—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Incants)—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Summoning magic? No, it takes too long! Defensive magic? Don't think I have enough mana...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Crap, I still can't use my staff properly here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, right. Flash magic?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm going to try the flashlight again!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: If the factory head was able to make it shine, then I should be able to use it to amplify my flash magic... right? But it might not be that useful against a group of monsters...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Whatever you do, do it quick! There's more of them by the second!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Fine! Here goes... Flash!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Laios
steps.text: Whoa! You took them all out at once!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Whoa! I did it! I think I'm starting to understand how to use the local magic!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You're the best, Flashlight! You're the first magic item I managed to use here!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Now's not the time! Their mucus got splashed everywhere!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Be careful! Make sure it doesn't touch your skin!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait, the flashlight, it's...?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What's happening?
The light coming from the tip of the D32 flashlight begins to dim, its components sparking and sizzling.
Before Marcille can even respond, thick smoke pours out of it as she drops it on the ground.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Flashlight!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille! Don't zone out now! You got splashed by the mucus too!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *sobs*... My flashlight...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I think it's broken.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why don't we see if the factory owner can fix it once we get back?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *sobs*...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: This mucus...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It smells pretty good, quite unlike the mucus from last time. It's more like...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's... sweet and sour!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You're right!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Ergh... You guys really need to stop putting bug mucus in your mouth.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm.. Tangy. I like it!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And what a beautiful color too! It's all bright and gold!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Gold, you say...?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The magic shot out from the flashlight turned the mucus gold and tasty...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I think we can use this as a replacement for the Goldglitter slugs!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm... The once-corrosive mucus became edible under the influence of magic... How fascinating.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But this type of mucus is normally stored inside the slug's body. We should gather it all up and make it edible first!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Don't tell me you want to use these on the ground...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: No, ingredients must be clean. These are fine for a taste test, but absolutely not for cooking.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: And there's not enough of them to make a dish anyway.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: If we're gonna make golden carrots, we'll still have to gather the mucus inside the slugs.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And how do we do that?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The ones from earlier were scared off by Marcille's magic. Before they return, we gather it from the ones that're still stunned.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm pretty sure the flashlight is broken, though.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why not try using your staff?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Alright... I'll try...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Did it work?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Looks like... no, the mucus hasn't changed.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Maybe give it another go?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hrgh!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: How about now?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Still no change... But why? Your magic seems to be a bit on-and-off as well, Marcille.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah, it's been like this since we arrived here. The only time I was able to gather enough mana was when I managed to use the flashlight successfully.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The factory head did say that D32 steel can withstand incredible amounts of energy.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The flashlight might have some amplification effect? The flash magic by itself wouldn't be enough in either the mana-gathering or casting stages.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Which means, I still need...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey, Laios, stop playing around with that slug! Are you even listening to Marcille at all?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Times like these, we just need to do what she says. This is her field of expertise, after all.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I've got it!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Laios
steps.text: Got what?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: With just my staff and the mana I have now, I can never change the mucus into what we need.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We'll need a conductor like the D32 steel to amplify it! There's no point doing any more tests with my staff!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We still need that flashlight!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think if you tried using it again while it's smoking like that, we'd just end up stunned like the slugs.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hey! When have I ever messed things up that badly?

spans.text: Hey! When have I ever messed things up

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The only reason you guys are making progress in this discussion is because I used the flashlight to make the mucus edible!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *Sigh* One moment, I managed to get a bit of an understanding of the local magic, and the next, my flashlight...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It doesn't seem to have melted at all from the acid. That 'D32 steel' stuff must be this silvery metal, right?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, Marcille just said the material is what's important, so it should be able to discharge magic no matter the shape, right?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What do you mean? Well, I'd assume so...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But why are you asking that all of a sudden?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Hmm?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Nooooo! Flashlight! My flashlight!!! Stop! Don't make it into a pot!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: The sooner we make these carrots, the sooner we find Rhodes Island, and the sooner we can save Falin, okay?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Look, it's not that bad. Remember that time my lockpicks were used to dig mimic meat out of its shell?

spans.text: bad. Remember that time my lockpicks were used to dig mimic meat out of its shell?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But Flashlight is different!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That's what I said about my lockpicks.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Pot's finished!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No! NOOOO!!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: It's just in a new form, is all. As a tool, it's still as handy as ever.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The form's really important, though!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So why don't you try doing that to the mucus now?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Rest in peace, Flashlight...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We shared such happy times together...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Don't worry. I won't let your sacrifice be in vain.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Incants)—

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Just a few things to go. Get these all out of here, and sell them to the scrapyard.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Man... I really don't want to do this...

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: We used to cook and eat here... Midnight snacks, barbecues, parties...

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Hmm? Something smells... really good.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: Huh... I smell it too...

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Where's it coming from? Is someone cooking outside?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'm cooking up some golden carrots for you folks.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Some... Some what?!

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: You actually managed to find some Goldglitters?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Nah, but we did find something else that'll turn the carrots golden.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Might not be traditional, but the color will do.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Should live up to your expectations for your last meal together.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: By the way, if you hadn't given me that flashlight, we wouldn't have been able to make this dish!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I wouldn't have been able to use my magic without it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's certainly not something nobody would appreciate!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: This taste...

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: I didn't think it'd be sweet-and-sour!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Amazing, right?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: It's delicious, though! It has this refreshing and fruity aroma!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Amazing, right?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm... I bet even Big Bob never realized you could prepare acid slugs like this.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Just think about it: sodas, smoothies... There're tons of good things you can make from them!

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: Thanks, boss. I mean it. I never thought we'd be able to eat golden carrot on our last day here.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: What're you thanking me for? It's them who did all the work.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: I will say though, this doesn't taste a lick like our first meal as a crew, but...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Back then, when we were eating golden carrot together, you said you wanted to join me and make this Rim Billiton's number one factory!

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: Haha! Who doesn't have one or two wild dreams when they're young?

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: It's not too late, either. Just need to start from scratch, is all.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Right. Now that there's someone who approves of my product, maybe my dream can live on.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Yeah, why not take your truck around some other towns a bit, and find somewhere else to make it a reality!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Oh right, the truck...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Hey, you guys wanted to buy my truck, right?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What? Oh, right!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Are you alright with it?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Not that we have much money in the first place...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: I'm definitely not selling it off. I still need it for my livelihood.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: But I can take you anywhere you like, as long as it's in Rim Billiton!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: And for free, too!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Consider it my thanks for the golden carrots!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: C'mon, eat up, then I'll take you where you need to go. As long as the engine's not kaput, we can go anywhere!
